data.name: Raayan
data.gender_notes: Raayan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'R-Y-N', meaning 'to see'. Raayan is a name for a bright, intelligent, and wise child. It is also associated with the ability to see beyond the ordinary, making it a fitting name for a child with a deep understanding of the world. The name Raayan carries the meaning “Intelligent, Wise, Bright” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Raayan usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, wise, bright and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Raayan is a name with deep spiritual significance. It is believed to be a name given to those who have a unique perspective on life, and the ability to see beyond the physical world. Raayan is a name for a child who is destined to make a positive impact on the world, and who will be guided by a strong spiritual foundation.
data.etymology: Raayan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Intelligent, Wise, Bright.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raayan total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
